runId.description: Run id: "<kind>-<yyyymmddThhmmss>-<4hex>" with kind discovery|replay and a UTC timestamp, e.g. "replay-20260929T101500-a1b2". Names the run evidence directory.

kind.description: What produced a run: an LLM-driven discovery run or a deterministic replay run.

endedAt.description: When the run ended; null while it is still running (or crashed).

artifact.description: The artifact replayed, or compiled by a discovery run; null when there is none (yet) or it was invalid.

anyOf.description: success: outputs returned. business_outcome: a valid business answer such as member_not_found (not a failure). failure: the run could not complete.

resultKind.description: The kind of the result in result.json; null until the run ends.

evidence.description: Every evidence file of the run; ids are unique.

logPath.description: Path of the run log inside the run directory, normally "run.jsonl".

redactionRulesVersion.description: Version of the redaction rules applied to every sink of this run, so a reviewer knows what was masked.

description: The index of one run directory (manifest.json): what ran, when, how it ended, and where its evidence is.

id.description: Capability id: a lowercase kebab-case slug, e.g. "member-lookup". Stable across artifact versions.

version.description: Version of the capability that ran.

contentHash.description: contentHash of the exact artifact document that ran.

ArtifactRef.description: Identifies the exact capability artifact a run used, without embedding it.

id.description: Evidence id: a lowercase kebab-case slug unique within the run, e.g. "screenshot-0003".

kind.description: What the evidence file holds: a masked screenshot, a redacted accessibility snapshot, a Playwright trace (local only), a redacted JSON document, or a redacted log.

path.description: A POSIX path relative to the run directory, e.g. "screenshots/0003-s06-click-search.png". No leading "/", no "." or ".." segment, no backslash, no scheme: evidence can never point outside its run.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the stored file bytes, as 64 lowercase hex characters. Detects tampering.

redacted.description: Always true: the file passed the redaction layer (or screenshot masking) before it was stored. A literal, so an unredacted ref cannot be represented (invariant 3).

localOnly.description: true for files that stay on the machine that produced them (e.g. traces, which cannot be fully masked); they are never copied into shared evidence.

EvidenceRef.description: A pointer to one stored evidence file of a run. The contract carries refs, never the evidence content.
